ORGAN: hdlab/vsa_cleanup_memory.py (CleanupMemory) -- its 5 self-tests are run by --self-test and must pass before any treatment number here is read.

P1_OPEN.what: the open pool of every eligible anchor; ANY WordNet gold member counts.

POOL_ORACLE_CHECK.note: an OPEN pool is not de-biased by construction and is EXPECTED to admit a winning constant; the value is reported so the reader can see how much.

P2_BALANCED_K15.what: de-biased: per-item pool = designated gold + 15 distractors drawn from the population of OTHER items' golds, so no constant ranking can beat chance 0.0625.

P2_BALANCED_K49.what: de-biased: per-item pool = designated gold + 49 distractors drawn from the population of OTHER items' golds, so no constant ranking can beat chance 0.0200.
